'''Evoc-Ra''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Voss commandos|Voss commando]] living on [[Voss]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he was killed at the [[Pelath-Ri Marches]] while escorting Voss scholars.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]]|A Last Stand|[[Voss]]}}</ref>
